experiment.name: accounting_diagnostic
experiment.result_label: ACCOUNTING DIAGNOSTIC — NOT FINAL RESEARCH RESULTS

universe.declared_assets_source: columns of the stored survivor-selected returns CSV

backtest.return_index_semantics: row t is the close t-1 to close t return
backtest.information_set: returns strictly before rebalance date t
backtest.execution_time: close t, after old holdings earn row t
backtest.first_return_earned_by_new_weights: first return row strictly after t

costs.rate_interpretation: cost per dollar of absolute risky-asset trade

diagnostic.target_source: stored legacy target weights in outputs/

limitations: The public Yahoo panel is survivor-conditioned and is not survivorship-bias-free.
Inactive-fund histories, historical identifiers, delisting proceeds, and point-in-time classifications are unavailable.
Cash earns zero because no validated, time-aligned risk-free series is stored.
No validated point-in-time next-open execution-price series is available.
The diagnostic reuses legacy targets and does not validate their estimators, optimizer comparison, risk matching, or hyperparameter selection.
